page.layout: One printed page: running head at top, one column of text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Below the last line: catchword at right and gathering signature at centre-left.

main_text.p: omnia hæc non honorata solùm[?],sed lauta quoque munera sunt, & opima. De cæte-ris, quæ collegio Doccumano cohærent, ut Scribæ & Fisci præfecti,quæ provinciæ huic cum Translavicanis sunt communia, & quæ his similia alia, dicere non libet, ne prolixior fiam. Et hæc quidem foris : reliqua domi. Horum primum&præcipuum Provinciale collegium, ut initio institutum fuit, collegas octo habuitCollegium Deputato-rum, uti vocât,quod nunc ad VIVIROS redactum., de-inde post sexennium sex habere cœpit, & adhuc habet, pari numero hinc inde lectos : de quorum munere amplissimo ante nobis dictum. Oppidanos senatus e-dit, & ferè ex his, qui in consulatu aut senatu fuêre, eosque pro arbitrio suo aut mutat anno exacto, aut in munere manere patitur. Nec alius agrariorum mos, qui reliquos designant. Collegæ, ut antè ostendi, per vices, atque in orbem præsident, alternatimque oppidanus & agrarius:vices septimana finiuntur. Quæstor autem collegii, cui amplissima pecunia tractanda committitur, item Scriba à secretis, conjunctim ab oppidanis & agrariis eliguntur in conventu communi,

page.notes: Right margin note: "Collegium Deputato-rum, uti vocât, quod nunc ad VIVIROS redactum." set in small italic, printed as one note over several lines. The first word of the first line ("solùm") is doubtful; the initial letter reads as an "s" or "i" and is marked [?]. The running head is printed as "Deque Vrbe Groninga" and is given here with u/v normalised. The catchword "muni," is printed at the right below the last line. Faint digitiser text at the lower right corner is not transcribed.
